items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: recording personnel for "Cherokee," by Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra. ... George Savaro, alto sax.

ctx.x: the Casa Loma Orchestra, the bands of Alvino Rey, Jan Garber, Teddy Powell, plus Jo Stafford, the Pied Pipers, and then it lists all the numbers. "St. Louis Blues," "No Name Jive," "Jive Bomber," recording personnel for "Cherokee," by Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra. Peanuts Holland, Al Killian, Howard McGhee, Paul Cohen, trumpets, Bob Swift, Eddie Burt, Trummy Young, Ed Fromm, trombones, Charlie Barnet, Steve Cole, George Savaro, alto sax.
Oh, that's why I couldn't -- it didn't look right. They have Savaro here.
